purpose.zh: 拉伸大腿内侧和后侧，在办公室就能做
purpose.en: Stretch the inner and back of your thighs, right at the office.

text.zh: 背部拉长，双手扶椅面，上身往前倾
text.en: Keep your back long, hands on the chair seat, and lean forward

text.zh: 双脚分得很宽，脚尖朝前，膝盖伸直但别锁死。
text.en: Stand with your feet wide, toes forward, knees straight but not locked.

text.zh: 呼气时臀部稍往后坐，胸口往下沉。
text.en: As you breathe out, sit your hips back a little and let your chest sink.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back and reaching for the floor.

cautions.zh: 起身时慢一点，头晕就先停
cautions.en: If you feel dizzy, stop, and come up slowly.

cautions.zh: 拉伸处疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your stretch hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 剂量 30 s 保持 → 2 组×6 次（rep_hold，stretchLoop）
节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：倾 2.1/停 2.0/回 2.2/歇 1.7 s
回来口令「慢慢起身」→「稍微起来」（动画始终扶着椅面，只回起一点）；caution 拆成两条短句
flags: 拉伸按次数：原剂量是静止计时，但动画每 8 秒做一次「进入-停住-回来」，按规则改成按次数（training.stretchLoop=true）；想改回计时需把动画改成一直停住，请定
